name: VeriField
one_liner: On-device vision diagnostics for low-connectivity agricultural clinics.

hard_problems.title: Field lighting and camera sensor drift
hard_problems.description: Models validated on clean benchmark photos suffer a 22% accuracy drop under harsh midday glare, lens dust, and non-target background objects in rural clinics.

hard_problems.title: Inference latency on budget Android hardware
hard_problems.description: Target devices have 3GB RAM and no cloud fallback; end-to-end preprocessing, classification, and confidence gating must finish under 60ms without thermal throttling.

hard_problems.title: Human review cost from overconfident false positives
hard_problems.description: Uncalibrated softmax scores route too many blurry or out-of-distribution images to paid agronomist review, blowing past the $0.02/scan margin budget.
